world.title: Why is US turning to Russia for diesel despite sanctions?
world.summary: President Donald Trump has reached an agreement to release diesel fuel stocks from Russia to address rising fuel prices in the U.S. ahead of the midterm elections. This decision comes despite existing sanctions against Russia. Analysts suggest that while the deal aims to alleviate costs, its effectiveness and implications remain uncertain as the elections approach.

world.title: Taiwan president says defence spending boost aims to ‘deter war’
world.summary: Taiwan President William Lai Ching-te, in a National Day speech, emphasized the island's commitment to peace and freedom while announcing a boost in defense spending to deter potential conflict. His statements drew condemnation from China, which accused Lai of distorting facts and misleading the public. The speech was delivered to a large audience outside the Presidential Office in Taipei.

world.title: Kamala Harris faces pushback over 2028 presidential bid as husband, Democratic donors express doubts: Report
world.summary: Former US Vice President Kamala Harris is encountering skepticism regarding a potential 2028 presidential bid. Reports indicate that her husband, Doug Emhoff, has privately suggested he would prefer she not run again. Additionally, some Democratic donors are expressing concerns about her viability as a candidate, reflecting a growing uncertainty within her support network about her future political ambitions.

business.title: 3 Upcoming Triumph Bikes in Next 2 Months: Tiger 900 to Street Triple 798
business.summary: Triumph will launch three updated motorcycle models in India over the next two months, starting in early 2027, using the Completely Built Unit (CBU) route. The models include the Tiger 900 and Street Triple 798. This follows the recent introduction of the Bonneville T4 and T40, priced at Rs 2.55 lakh and Rs 2.80 lakh, respectively.

business.title: Mahindra Thar Roxx Spied With OG Alloys - DaVinci Suspension Confirmed
business.summary: New spy shots of the Mahindra Thar Roxx reveal suspension upgrades and a new alloy-wheel design, indicating an upcoming update. The vehicle was observed testing with mostly uncovered bodywork, suggesting significant changes. The DaVinci suspension has been confirmed, enhancing the vehicle's performance. These developments highlight Mahindra's ongoing efforts to improve the Thar Roxx model ahead of its release.

technology.title: E-commerce festive sales kick off with strong demand from smaller towns, premium buys gain traction
technology.summary: India's festive e-commerce season has begun robustly, with significant demand from tier-3 towns. Major platforms like Flipkart, Amazon, Myntra, and Meesho reported increased orders and customer engagement. Shoppers are opting for premium products across categories such as electronics, fashion, beauty, and home goods, while rapid delivery services are enhancing the overall shopping experience during this festive period.

technology.title: Apple set to debut touch-screen MacBook and new iPad mini in late October
technology.summary: Apple Inc. is preparing for a product launch in late October, expected around Tuesday, October 27. The event will feature the introduction of its first touch-screen MacBook and a new iPad mini. Additionally, Apple plans to unveil M6 Macs and an upgraded smart home ecosystem. This follows a previously announced smart home strategy reveal scheduled for next week.

technology.title: iQOO 16, Motorola Signature 27 Flagship Phones Teased Ahead Of India Launch - Check Key Features
technology.summary: iQOO and Motorola unveiled their upcoming flagship smartphones, iQOO 16 and Motorola Signature 27, at the India Mobile Congress 2026 in New Delhi. iQOO has confirmed its launch plans for India, while Motorola has shared details about the camera and software features of its new device. Both phones are anticipated to attract significant consumer interest.

sports.title: Bayern Munich News: Phil Foden to FC Bayern? Only if it’s a sweet deal
sports.summary: Bayern Munich's interest in Phil Foden remains unconfirmed, with no solid offers reported. Vincent Kompany's familiarity with Foden from their time at Manchester City could influence any potential transfer. However, Bayern will only pursue Foden if the deal is favorable. The club continues to explore various transfer options as the window progresses, aiming to strengthen their squad.

sports.title: 'Just install a bowling machine': Yuzvendra Chahal’s blunt take on batter-friendly pitches after West Indies chase down 250
sports.summary: Yuzvendra Chahal expressed frustration over batter-friendly pitches after India’s 250-run total was insufficient to secure a win against the West Indies. This match has reignited discussions regarding the increasing dominance of batters in T20 cricket. Chahal's blunt comment suggested that such conditions favor batters excessively, prompting calls for a reevaluation of pitch preparation in the format.

sports.title: How Cristiano Jr. could represent other countries in international football as Ronaldo’s dispute with Portugal coach Jorge Jesus rumbles on
sports.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo's ongoing dispute with Portugal coach Jorge Jesus raises questions about his international future. Meanwhile, attention turns to his son, Cristiano Jr., who could potentially represent other countries in international football. The situation highlights the complexities of national representation and the implications for both Ronaldo and his son as they navigate their respective paths in the sport.

health.title: No Gluten, No Pink Salt: Suniel Shetty, 65, Reveals His 1600-Calorie Daily Diet
health.summary: Actor Suniel Shetty, at 65, maintains a disciplined 1600-calorie daily diet focused on portion control and protein intake. His typical breakfast consists of four egg whites, with fish or chicken included in other meals. Shetty emphasizes eating according to his body's needs and finishes dinner by 7 PM. His approach to fitness continues to attract attention.

health.title: Skin rashes in children: Paediatrician explains common causes, warning signs and when parents should worry
health.summary: Skin rashes in children can indicate various issues, including allergies and infections. A paediatrician outlines common causes, such as viral infections, dengue, chickenpox, and eczema. Parents should be aware of warning signs that necessitate medical attention. Understanding the nature of the rash and accompanying symptoms is crucial for determining when to seek professional help for their child.

health.title: Viola Davis grew up in poverty in Rhode Island; now she and husband Julius Tennon are donating $1.2 million to help local families
health.summary: Viola Davis, an award-winning actress from Rhode Island, and her husband, Julius Tennon, are donating $1.2 million to support local families. Davis, who grew up in poverty, emphasizes the importance of her roots despite her successful Hollywood career. The donation aims to assist those in need in her hometown, reflecting her commitment to giving back to the community.

science.title: These origami-inspired rover wheels could make lunar exploration easier
science.summary: Researchers at KAIST have developed origami-inspired, fire-proof wheels for lunar rovers, intended for deployment in 2030. These wheels can compress from a 20-inch diameter to nine inches, allowing easier navigation through the Moon's lava tubes, which present challenges due to steep slopes and drops. This innovative design aims to enhance lunar exploration capabilities significantly.

science.title: Solar Storm Tomorrow: Powerful geomagnetic storm to hit Earth - Will it affect India? Possible impact explained
science.summary: NOAA has issued a G2 geomagnetic storm warning for October 11, predicting effects from two solar eruptions. The storm may impact satellites, navigation systems, and radio signals. While the storm's intensity is moderate, its potential effects on India are being assessed. Authorities are monitoring the situation to determine the extent of disruptions that may occur.

science.title: A Starquake 10 Billion Years Ago May Have Just Sent A Flash To Earth
science.summary: A fast radio burst (FRB), detected on Earth, originated from a starquake over 10 billion years ago, marking it as the farthest FRB confirmed to date. This brief flash of radio waves traveled through space for an extensive period before reaching our planet. FRBs are known for their short duration, lasting only a few thousandths of a second.

entertainment.title: EXCLUSIVE: “Weak writing was the main reason Toxic didn’t work,” says Taran Adarsh; praises Yash as “very confident” actor
entertainment.summary: Trade analyst Taran Adarsh stated that "weak writing" was the primary reason the film Toxic failed to resonate with audiences. In an exclusive interview with Bollywood Hungama, he emphasized the importance of strong storytelling in filmmaking. Adarsh also commended actor Yash, describing him as a "very confident" performer, highlighting his contributions to the film despite its shortcomings.

entertainment.title: WWE Money In The Bank 2026: Full Match Card, Start Time And How To Watch
entertainment.summary: WWE Money in the Bank 2026 is scheduled for tonight in New Orleans at the Smoothie King Center. The event features two ladder matches and two title matches, including a World Heavyweight Championship match opening the show. Fans can find the full match card, start times for various regions, and viewing options for the Reigns vs. LA Knight match.

entertainment.title: When Shah Rukh Khan revealed Nana Patekar got him out of jail: ‘He was very sweet’
entertainment.summary: Shah Rukh Khan shared a story about Nana Patekar helping him during a difficult time in the early 1990s, specifically regarding his release from jail. In a resurfaced video, Khan recounted how he confronted a journalist over an article, bringing a ceremonial sword gifted by his father-in-law. He acknowledged that his actions were misguided and expressed gratitude for Patekar's support.
